Rules / Formatting

SK0204 The default value expression is not arranged

skala arrange would use default or default(T) under the configured preference.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSemantic
Needs a compilationyes
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floorC# 7.1
Since2.0

Why

A default literal is safe only when its target type is known. The semantic rule proves that target before removing a written type, and can restore the explicit form when the configuration asks for it.

Example

Instead of:

CancellationToken token = default(CancellationToken);

Write:

CancellationToken token = default;

When it does not fire

None relative to the effective configuration. Expressions without a stable target type are not rewritten.

Configuration

  • resharper_csharp_default_value_when_type_evident
  • resharper_csharp_default_value_when_type_not_evident
